The '''Oseon asteroid belt''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]]. The belt was home to a chain of the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] development company [[Planet Dreams, Incorporated]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref>
